best_match.fbbt_definition: Follicle cell of the germarium that migrates posteriorly and covers the nurse cells during stage 9. There are approximately 50 of these follicle cells that flatten to form a squamous domain over the nurse cells.

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00004908 'stretch follicle cell', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
